content.text: issues.resolution and resolved_at both exist. The stable id does not, so the one column that says why an issue closed is keyed on localized text.

Measured: demo mirror resolution 'Done' on 166 rows; oss mirror '완료' on 343 rows — the same resolution under two names. The raw payload carries "id": "10000". The demo changelog has 356 rows with field = resolution. There is no resolution_id column.
This is the repo's standing trap in a place we have not closed yet: "only the ones closed as Won't Do" filters to zero rows on a Korean account, exactly like WHERE status = 'In Progress' does.

Fix shape: a resolution_id column projected alongside the existing name; logic keys on the id, display uses the name; a RECIPES entry for "why did these close" that uses the id. The changelog's resolution rows should likewise expose from/to ids rather than only names.
Gate: a fixture with a localized resolution name filters correctly by id and returns nothing when filtered by the English name.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track C, score 7/10).
